messages:
maria: Hey team — quick design check on the vectors preview + rerank controls for batch uploads. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC123 (frame: "Vectors Preview / Rerank v3"). I want feedback on export placement, keyboard flow, and microcopy. @ryan @jamal

alex: Looked at the mock. My first concern: export dropdown currently sits in the table header and overlaps the column titles at narrow widths. On 800px it covers the top row. Might need to move it into a separate toolbar or make it sticky outside the table.

jamal: Accessibility nits: keyboard order is off. When tabbing, focus goes into a preview card before the export button — export should be reachable via keyboard before diving into content. Also relevance badges fail contrast on the purple variant (ratio ~3.2:1).

olivia: Product ask: export CSV needs to include original_text, vector_id, similarity_score, and the rerank_position. We also need a note in the export modal describing how rerank_position is computed (descending similarity).

ryan: Agreed with alex about placement. Proposal: toolbar above table with grouping: [Batch actions] [Rerank controls] [Export ▾]. On smaller screens collapse to a single kebab menu. Will prototype sticky toolbar that shrinks. Also can add keyboard shortcut `e` to open export.

maria: Thanks. Microcopy suggestions: change "Export results" -> "Export results (CSV)" to reduce ambiguity. For the rerank button label, prefer "Rerank by relevance" instead of "Rerank" to be explicit. Also move the export into the left side of the toolbar (so primary table controls stay right).

design-bot: Accessibility scan: detected aria-live missing on rerank results. Recommend `role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\"` for update announcements. Also flag: icons used without aria-labels in preview cards.

jamal: For screen readers: sample snippet — `aria-live=\"polite\"` and announce "Reranking complete: top result score 0.87". Avoid using only colors to indicate relevance; add textual hint like "High relevance"/"Low relevance" for badges.

alex: CSS fix for header overlap: quick patch idea —

```
.table-container { padding-top: 48px; }
.toolbar { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 48px; }
```

But sticky toolbar is probably cleaner. Ryan, if you do sticky, watch z-index with modals.

ryan: Noted. Will implement sticky toolbar with `position: sticky; top: 0;` and a separate stacking context for modals (z-index: 1200). Also will add focus trap for export dialog.

olivia: One more product constraint: rerank should be inline (no blocking modal) as long as latency < 500ms. If > 500ms show unobtrusive toast/spinner and put results into the preview pane. That preserves context.

maria: Good rule. Decision checklist for implementation: 1) Move export to left toolbar and label "Export results (CSV)". 2) Keyboard shortcut `e` + make export reachable via Tab before preview cards. 3) Add `aria-live=\"polite\"` and textual relevance labels. 4) Contrast change: darker purple swatch and bold text for badges. 5) CSV columns include original_text and rerank_position + modal copy. 6) Inline rerank when <= 500ms, fallback spinner + toast if slower.

jamal: I'll add a small a11y doc with focus order and SR announcement examples.

alex: I'll land the header overlap hotfix and add tests for responsive breakpoints.

ryan: I'll push a prototype branch by EOD with sticky toolbar, export modal skeleton, and keyboard shortcut wiring.

maria: Perfect — follow-up: please drop links to PR and prototype here when ready. Filing a tiny visual follow-up item for microcopy changes and contrast tokens. :thumbsup:

olivia: Thanks everyone — filing a backlog ticket for export telemetry (who exported, size) so we can audit.

alex: ack :+1:

design-bot: Accessibility checklist updated: +1 item for aria-live, +1 for color contrast.

maria: Closing for now. We'll reconvene after the prototype.
